answer: Nonce-bound answer gate: each registrant gets a fresh nonce and ledger head and must submit a signed answer whose hash is unseen, with duplicate-answer and reused-nonce checks rejecting replays. The challenge embeds a rotating quill token, so old answers cannot match the new prompt. A lagoon seed changes daily, forcing a fresh derivation for every admission. Each identity pays one nonrefundable fee plus one memory-hard pulse of work, so bulk Sybils pay that full cost per account.
